packageRules.description: typescript-eslint supports TypeScript below 6.1 only; raise this once it supports newer versions
eslint-plugin-react, which eslint-config-next uses, supports ESLint 9 only; raise this once it supports ESLint 10

mcav-installer shades and relocates the Maven resolver, so its packages are rewritten at build time; a bump that moves or adds packages silently escapes the relocation list, which an auto-merged pull request would not catch. Updates for that module are therefore raised by hand.
